text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-86079, Hammered Arts and Crafts Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair

The Back-to-Back 8 Inch Arts and Crafts Pull Set has a hammered design that adds the rustic southwest flair that is so perfect for ranch style homes. This Hammered Arts and Crafts Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair comes packaged with everything you'll need to install it including 2 pulls, one for each side of the door, and the hardware to mount them back-to-back on 1-3/8 inch to 2-1/4 inch thick doors. The Arts and Crafts 8 Inch Back-to-Back Pull Set is available in oil rubbed bronze, satin nickel, matte black, and brass finishes.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Arts and Crafts Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Arts and Crafts Solid Brass Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Total Length: 8-7/8"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1-1/8"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Base: 1-1/8"
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
